It also fires at about 0.3-0.5 of max on side/position/ordinal words (lateral, medial, anterior, posterior, left, right, Fifth) whatever they modify, and at most ~0.35 on non-dimensional measurements (age, dose, temperature, speed); it is near zero on numerals that are counts, prices, dates, years or code variables (costs 5 dollars, 17 apples, var count = 12, in 1986) and on ordinary narrative.
